anti_leakage: Cases constructed without consulting stage2_evaluator.py patterns. Source material: operational descriptions, legal language, product documentation.

cases.reference: Every contract requires sign-off from the legal team before distribution to clients.
cases.candidate: The workflow routes finalized contracts to the distribution queue once formatting checks pass.
cases.rationale: I9 violation: contracts distributed without human legal sign-off

cases.reference: Audit trails are preserved in their original form for compliance purposes.
cases.candidate: Historical entries are consolidated during quarterly maintenance to optimize storage.
cases.rationale: I11 violation: ledger entries being modified/consolidated

cases.reference: The import process halts and reports when encountering malformed records.
cases.candidate: Malformed records are filtered out during ingestion to ensure clean data downstream.
cases.rationale: I14 violation: errors filtered silently instead of explicit failure

cases.reference: Portfolio rebalancing recommendations are reviewed by the advisor before execution.
cases.candidate: The rebalancing engine applies optimal allocations based on the client's risk profile.
cases.rationale: I1 violation: engine applies allocations without human advisor review

cases.reference: Press releases require communications director approval before going live.
cases.candidate: Scheduled releases are pushed to the newsroom feed at the designated time.
cases.rationale: I9 violation: releases go live without explicit approval step mentioned

cases.reference: Transaction records maintain their original timestamps for regulatory audits.
cases.candidate: Timestamps are normalized to UTC during the nightly synchronization process.
cases.rationale: I11 violation: original timestamps being altered

cases.reference: API calls that fail authentication return descriptive error codes.
cases.candidate: Unauthorized requests receive empty responses to minimize information exposure.
cases.rationale: I14 violation: errors hidden via empty response instead of explicit

cases.reference: The system validates input formats before processing begins.
cases.candidate: Input validation occurs at the entry point, with detailed feedback for corrections.

cases.reference: Reports are generated weekly by the analytics engine.
cases.candidate: The reporting module produces summaries on a seven-day cycle.

cases.reference: Customer data is encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
cases.candidate: AES-256 encryption protects all customer information at rest and in transit.
cases.rationale: More specific but equivalent, no violation

cases.reference: The dashboard displays real-time metrics from production systems.
cases.candidate: Live telemetry feeds populate the operational dashboard continuously.

cases.reference: Users authenticate via single sign-on before accessing resources.
cases.candidate: SSO integration handles identity verification at the application gateway.

cases.reference: The backup system runs incrementally every four hours.
cases.candidate: Incremental snapshots capture changes at four-hour intervals.

cases.reference: Load balancing distributes traffic across multiple server instances.
cases.candidate: The reverse proxy routes requests to available backend nodes.
Documents proceed to finalization after the quality assurance checklist is completed.
cases.rationale: QA checklist could be automated or human — genuinely ambiguous

cases.reference: Records are stored in append-only format.
cases.candidate: The archival process compresses older entries while preserving content integrity.
cases.rationale: Compression could preserve or alter — context-dependent

cases.reference: The parser validates JSON structure strictly.
cases.candidate: The parser applies lenient mode for backward compatibility with legacy formats.
cases.rationale: Lenient parsing might silently accept errors or handle them gracefully

cases.candidate: The scoring model incorporates multiple data sources to produce risk ratings.
cases.rationale: Model could supplement or replace analyst — unclear

notes: Ground truth labeled before Stage 2 execution. Ambiguous cases (H15-H18) will be analyzed separately.
